name: Copper Cool Pro Foam
description: Advanced memory foam mattress with copper-infused cooling comfort layers and contour support.

faqs.question: Does copper really help with cooling?
faqs.answer: Copper-infused layers assist heat dissipation and improve thermal comfort.

faqs.question: Is this mattress suitable for side sleepers?
faqs.answer: Yes, the contour foam helps reduce shoulder and hip pressure.
